title: Sparkles Cupcake Kiosk
summary: A single-page ordering kiosk for the Sparkles cupcake shop counter, displaying today's flavor lineup, a highlighted special of the day, and a running tally of orders placed, built as a self-contained static HTML page.

features.name: Shop title display
features.acceptance: The page contains an element with data-testid="title" whose text content includes the shop name "Sparkles" (e.g. 'Sparkles Cupcake Kiosk'), so the kiosk is clearly branded.

features.name: Today's flavor list
features.acceptance: The page contains an element with data-testid="flavor-list" that has at least three child items, each representing a distinct cupcake flavor drawn from the trend notes (for example Pumpkin Spice, Maple, Matcha-Strawberry, Chili-Chocolate, Earl Grey-Lavender, Biscoff Raspberry, Belgian Chocolate Peanut Butter, Classic Vanilla, Classic Chocolate, or Classic Strawberry), with each flavor's name visible as text within its list item.

features.name: Special of the day callout
features.acceptance: The page contains an element with data-testid="special" that displays a single named cupcake flavor as today's special (e.g. a trending seasonal or fusion flavor like Pumpkin Spice or Biscoff Raspberry), with descriptive text distinguishing it from the regular flavor-list entries.

features.name: Order button and counter
features.acceptance: The page contains a button element with data-testid="order-btn" containing visible label text (e.g. 'Place Order'), and a separate element with data-testid="order-count" that displays a starting numeric value (e.g. '0') representing the running count of orders placed; both elements exist in the static HTML markup.

done_when: A static analyzer of the rendered HTML confirms: (1) an element with data-testid="title" exists and its text includes "Sparkles"; (2) an element with data-testid="flavor-list" exists and contains at least three child flavor items with readable flavor names; (3) an element with data-testid="special" exists and names a single specific flavor as the day's special; (4) a data-testid="order-btn" button element and a data-testid="order-count" element both exist with visible text/labels; and (5) the page is fully self-contained with no external script or stylesheet references.
